## Hermes QA Dashboard

The QA Dashboard is an extension in this fork. It adds QA configuration, versioned Test Assets, Test Planning, Test Cycles, execution monitoring, results, artifacts, reports, and delivery integrations.

The upstream README, license, and attribution are intentionally preserved.
